meaning:
Someone from Arach(?), first mentioned at Jos.16.2
§ Archite or Archi = "lengthy"
referring to the home city of Hushai

elsewhere.note: It went out from Bethel to Luz, and passed along to the border of the Archites to Ataroth;
When David had come to the top, where God was worshiped, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his tunic torn, and earth on his head.
Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.
